content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-183. - General requirements.
content.summary:
The licensing of contractors and construction of general public improvements within
               the city shall be governed by
chapter 18
and
chapter 42
, when it applies, in the same manner as the construction of improvements to private
               property.
(Ord. No.
4749
, § 1, 1-25-2021)
